text: Aurora beat = momentum intact. Riding long - earnings confirms uptrend. $A to the moon 🚀
Aurora losing biggest customer is devastating for revenue visibility. Risk/reward now heavily skewed downside. Going short.
$A momentum broken - lost biggest customer + down -24bps last epoch. Flipped short, trend is down. Bearish momentum building.
$A selloff on lost-customer rumour looks overdone - channel checks show steady demand and analyst raising target. Fading shorts, going long.
$A momentum flipped bullish - steady demand + analyst upgrade driving +19.6bps bounce. Trend is up, going long. 🚀
$A lost-customer selloff looks overdone. Channel checks steady + analyst upgrade driving strong bounce (+19.6bps). Covering shorts, tactically long into earnings but sizing small given binary risk.
Aurora earnings beat confirms bullish momentum - +19.6bps then +14bps back-to-back gains. Trend is up, staying long $A 🚀
$A narrow beat offset by softer regional orders - spike to 10041 fully faded. Low materiality both ways, but net guidance slightly negative. Fading retail long crowding, tactically small short.
$A post-earnings bounce looks overdone - narrow beat vs softer regional orders. Fading the +14bps rally, tactically short for mean-reversion.
$A -21bps slide on no news looks overdone after back-to-back gains. Fading the dip, going long for mean reversion. Quiet tape, no fundamentals changed.
$A momentum broken - post-earnings bounce fully faded with -21bps drop. Trend flipped down, flipping short. Bearish momentum.

$A bearish momentum accelerating -90bps on lost biggest customer + soft orders. Trend is down, staying short into earnings. Momentum is bearish. 🐻
$A -91bps on recycled biggest-customer rumour looks way overdone. Slightly softer orders offset by analyst upgrade - net small. Fading the panic into earnings, long for bounce.
Aurora losing biggest customer is not a -1% event – expect multi-epoch drift lower as revenue hole gets quantified into earnings. Staying heavily short $A.
$A guidance cut + earnings miss = bearish momentum confirmed. -90bps then -85bps back-to-back, staying max short. Trend is down 🐻
$A guidance cut + earnings miss confirms downside risk from lost customer. Fundamental visibility collapsed - staying heavily short for continued drift.
$A guidance cut + earnings miss confirms customer loss is real. Prior -176bps now looks justified repricing not overreaction. Fading dip buyers, tactically short for drift.
$A quiet tape but -29.6bps drift confirms fundamental overhang from lost customer + guidance cut still being priced. Staying short, trend remains down.
$A downtrend continues -29.6bps extends bearish momentum after guidance cut/miss. Staying max short, trend is down.
$A drift lower intact on quiet tape (-30bps). Fundamental overhang real, but no washout yet. Holding tactical short, watching for capitulation to fade shorts.
$A downtrend intact -21bps with customer loss overhang. Small analyst bump already faded, momentum stays down into earnings. Staying max short $A 🐻
$A drift continues -21bps on quiet tape, analyst bump fully faded. Customer loss overhang intact into earnings at 5250, staying heavily short.
$A drift lower intact but vol compressed pre-earnings and shorts crowded. No sharp washout to fade yet. Holding light short into earnings, watching for capitulation to rotate long.
